english.title: Make demand relating to radioactive device / material / nuclear facility - Terrorism Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in the course of or in connection with the commission of an act of terrorism or for the purposes of terrorism, made a demand

(A)_[for the supply to yourself or another of a radioactive device]_
(B)_[for the supply to yourself or another of radioactive material]_
(C)_[for a nuclear facility to be made available to yourself or to another]_
(D)_[for access to a nuclear facility to be given to yourself or to another]_

and supported the demand with a threat that you or another would take action if the demand was not met; and the circumstances and manner of the threat were such that it was reasonable for the person to whom it was made to assume that there was a real risk that the threat would be carried out if the demand was not met
english.legislation: Contrary to section 11(1) and (4) of the Terrorism Act 2006.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) Also consider the following offence wordings: Make radioactive device with intent to use in commission/preparation of terrorism (H8460); Possess radioactive device/material with intent to use in commission/preparation of terrorism (H8465); Use radioactive device/material for purposes of terrorism (H8461); Use/damage a nuclear facility for purposes of terrorism (H8463); Make threat to use radioactive material/device/nuclear facility (H8464).
(ii) This offence applies to acts done outside the United Kingdom regardless of the nationality of the offender, see section 17.
(iii) For the liability of company directors etc. see section 18.
(iv) Proceedings for this offence require the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions, section 19.
(v) See also Home Office Circular 8/2006 , including explanations about this section.

other.powersofarrest:
For terrorist offences primarily consider: Arrest without warrant - terrorism
Also applicable: Arrest without warrant
other.penalty:
Imprisonment for life.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None This offence is also specified as a serious terrorism offence (Part 1 of Schedule 17A to the Sentencing Act 2020) and subject to serious terrorism sentences of imprisonment or extended sentences; see note (v) in section 306 for details.
